\documentclass[journal]{IEEEtran}

%% IEEEtran ships with TeX Live and Overleaf, so it is not vendored. For a
%% camera-ready submission, vendor the exact IEEEtran.cls/.bst the transaction
%% requires into this directory — publishers check the version.

\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage{microtype}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{amssymb}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{enumitem}

\graphicspath{{figures/}{./}}

%% Citations: natbib in every template, so \citep and \citet work identically
%% whichever template the document uses. IEEEtranN.bst is the natbib-compatible
%% IEEEtran style — plain IEEEtran.bst renders \citet as "(author?)".
\usepackage[numbers,sort&compress]{natbib}

\input{metadata}
\usepackage{researchcommon}

%% Acronyms — load order is load-bearing, all before hyperref.
\usepackage[acronym,nopostdot,nonumberlist]{glossaries-extra}
\makenoidxglossaries
\RestoreAcronyms
\setacronymstyle{long-short}
\input{acronyms}

\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}
\usepackage{cleveref}

\hypersetup{
  pdftitle={\PaperTitle},
  pdfauthor={\PaperAuthorList},
  pdfsubject={\PaperSubject},
  pdfkeywords={\PaperKeywords},
}

\begin{document}

\title{\PaperTitle}

%% Journal mode wants \IEEEauthorblockN only (no \IEEEauthorblockA); affiliations
%% conventionally go in a \thanks. To add an author, uncomment their macros in
%% metadata.tex and extend this block.
\author{%
  \IEEEauthorblockN{\AuthorOneName}%
  \thanks{\AuthorOneName{} is with \AuthorOneAffil{} (e-mail: \AuthorOneEmail).}%
}

%% Running heads, journal mode only.
\markboth{\PaperShortTitle}%
         {\AuthorOneName \MakeLowercase{\textit{et al.}}: \PaperShortTitle}

\maketitle

\begin{abstract}
  \input{abstract}
\end{abstract}

\begin{IEEEkeywords}
  \PaperKeywords
\end{IEEEkeywords}

\IEEEpeerreviewmaketitle

\input{text}

\bibliographystyle{IEEEtranN}
\bibliography{references}
